title: The Cuckoo Clock Mutiny
crime_description: The master gears in the astronomical town clock were reprogrammed so the cuckoo shrieks like an enraged rooster.

suspect.name: Ignatius 'Cogs' Geary
suspect.quirk: Intersperses his speech with ticking noises ('tick-tick', 'tock') and mechanical timekeeping metaphors.

dossier.text: A brass 14-tooth escapement gear stamped with serial number IG-99 was left on the belfry gear rack.
The tower keeper found muddy size-9 workboot prints ascending the external maintenance ladder at 10:00 PM.
An audio recording cassette labeled 'Enraged Farm Cockerel 1994' was found missing from Ignatius's workshop.

truth_timeline.event: Ignatius grabs his size-9 boots and rooster audio tape from his workshop.
Ignatius scales the belfry external maintenance ladder in muddy boots.
Ignatius drops his custom stamped gear IG-99 while swapping the chiming bellows.

lie_plan.cover_story: Ignatius insists he never fabricates numbered brass escapements, has severe vertigo preventing him from climbing ladders, and only collects recordings of gentle Swiss songbirds.

weak_points.claim: Tick-tock, I never engrave custom serial numbers or initials on my clockwork cogs.
weak_points.planned_slip: Tick-tick! My pendulum swings true! I have never stamped 'IG-99' onto any 14-tooth brass escapement gear in my entire precision career!

weak_points.claim: I suffer from debilitating altitude sickness and would never scale any external tower ladder.
weak_points.planned_slip: Tock! My balance wheel spins out at heights! I never put on heavy size-9 boots or climbed up the exterior belfry ladder at ten o'clock!

weak_points.claim: My audio library consists strictly of tranquil alpine nightingales, never barnyard fowl.
weak_points.planned_slip: Tick! Scurrilous vibrations! I harbor no farmyard rooster recordings whatsoever; my acoustic cassettes feature only soothing Swiss doves!

solution_contradictions: Suspect claims he never stamped 'IG-99' on a gear, contradicting Fact 1 (gear IG-99 found at scene).
Suspect claims he never climbed the ladder or wore size-9 boots, contradicting Fact 2 (size-9 bootprints on ladder at 10 PM).
Suspect claims he has no rooster recordings, contradicting Fact 3 (Enraged Cockerel cassette missing from his shop).
